caption: Mastbos, Breda
composition: Straight sandy lane of pines and beech at the forest edge · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: At the Mastbos edge near Ginneken a straight sandy lane runs between Scots pines and beeches. The trees are still in leaf in late September, with a little early yellow and no flower color. The sky is clear, about 11.5°C, with wind near 6.5 km/h, and a bright moon is up. Breda Castle is not in this frame.
